missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Исследование' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Это' and 'важное' show neuter agreement, evaluating the study.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Исследование' is the accusative direct object of 'провели'; neuter inanimate accusative equals nominative. 'Большое' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Исследования' is genitive, showing whose results these are. 'Результаты' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Исследовании' is prepositional after 'в', marking participation in the study. 'Сто человек' is the nominative quantity subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Исследованием' is instrumental, governed by 'руководит', which always takes that case. 'Научным' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Исследованию' is dative after 'к', marking what they began. 'Новому' agrees in the neuter dative.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Исследования' is the accusative plural object of 'финансирует'; neuter inanimate plural accusative equals nominative. 'Важные' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Исследования' is genitive after 'без', expressing lack. 'Сделать вывод' is the infinitive phrase of the impersonal clause.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Исследования' is the nominative plural subject of 'подтверждают'. 'Многие' agrees, and 'теорию' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Исследования' is genitive after 'из', marking where the conclusion comes from. 'Вывод' is the nominative subject.
